close_reason: Test-backend stringly-typed dispatch; not public API, not worth abstracting.
description: tests/common/mod.rs query_objects: dispatches on O::TYPE_NAME == 'Email' / 'EmailSubmission' as runtime string comparisons to select the right filter type. This defeats the generic type parameter — the correct approach is to add filter-application as a method to the QueryObject or GetObject trait (or a separate FilterApplicable trait), so each concrete type carries its own filter logic. As-is, adding a new type requires modifying query_objects with another if O::TYPE_NAME == 'NewType' branch, which is an open/closed violation in a test harness that is meant to serve as the canonical MailBackend example.
title: query_objects type-name string comparison is stringly-typed dispatch
